original_reference_provenance.finding: Historical Julia code copies expected res_* assembly files and touches CUDA; it does not compute k-mer counts or sequence assembly. This is an S1 semantic placeholder. Preserve original bytes and implement the actual native hash/CAS/cohort/quality-rating/iterative-walk algorithm. Native lane expression also has a concrete initialization defect; its minimal original GPU probe happened to match, so no observed original numerical failure is claimed. Scoped lane-mask repair and diagnostic output initialization are conditional native interventions.

scope_limits: Integrated right-walk kernel only; left reverse complement/stitching and file parser unmeasured.
Five K21 fixtures; arbitrary K, short reads, biological datasets and formal race freedom not certified.
